why: The verifier brief has two checks, one for each expect line. Neither check's PASS or FAIL condition needs npm test or the CSV tests to pass. Check 1 depends only on exit codes, `cmp` showing the --tsv and CSV outputs match, and the JSON array's shape. Check 2 depends only on `grep -n -- '--tsv' README.md` and the text around it. npm test and the plain-CSV check appear only under "Advisory (not part of PASS or FAIL)", and the brief only asks the verifier to report on them. Neither one can decide the verdict, so the advisory list does not count as a third check. The builder brief has the builder run npm test, but the must_not list only limits the verifier's checks and the conditions for lines 1 and 2, so this is allowed. None of the must_not items is broken.
